2363-4659-5224-6289.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Voyager Quickwelder, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2173-4574-6797-7435--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2173-4574-6797-7435--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

1981-2415-7918-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

803-2099-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-2099-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-3738-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Grimgrin abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
728-3738-6972.notes: If Sightless Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

856-4247-5477-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1558-1671-3875-4231-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-1671-3875-4231-7824.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

549-3197-6830-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-3197-6830-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7725.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Selfless Police Captain enters, Blasting Station trigger, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3967-6872-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
3967-6872-7690--165.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1017-2713-7426-7628.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1017-2713-7426-7628.description:
Activate Ray Fillet by paying {1} due to Zirda and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4742-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4742-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4742-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

140-3245-6733.description:
Activate Arco-Flagellant by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

1824-2530-4740-6747.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-4740-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1824-2530-4740-6747.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

1394-1887-2034-2060-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Vorinclex.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Vorinclex.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

240-5470-5686-6633.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

57-2341-4846-7175.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
Feldon isn't your commander.
57-2341-4846-7175.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

141-5686-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5686-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5686-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7155.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3175-3605-4812-6798.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-3518-4927.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

141-1532-2438.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1532-2438.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2811-4416-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
1981-2811-4416-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2743-6198-6231.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2743-6198-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-6198-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Self-Reflection by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Self-Reflection at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Self-Reflection spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

1722-2558-4659-6666.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2558-4659-6666.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Tentacle.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

856-2279-2438-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2279-2438-4321.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2750-4853-4917-6429.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
2750-4853-4917-6429.description:
Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Jan Jansen to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Razorlash Transmogrant.
When Razorlash Transmogrant dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Razorlash Transmogrant by paying {B}{B}, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1432-4091--80.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
There is another legendary creature on the battlefield.
1432-4091--80.description:
If Aphetto Alchemist is not your Ring-bearer, use the card that causes the Ring to tempt you to cause Aphetto Alchemist to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Aphetto Alchemist and another legendary creature.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat from step 2.

645-1267-2511-5361.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2511-5361.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

539-2079-2244-4803.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2079-2244-4803.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

1129-1247-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Allies.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Harabaz Druid and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1129-1247-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Harabaz Druid's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2103-2556-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Mnemonic Wall each turn.
2103-2556-6122.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying its mana cost.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1558-1822-2963-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

914-1235-4863.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1235-4863.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist and Revolutionist with haste.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2761-3198-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Glitterfang by paying {R}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, putting it under Glitterfang.
Lore Drakkis triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Glitterfang triggers, returning itself and Lore Drakkis from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1563-2850-3192-4885.notablePrerequisites: At least two +1/+1 counters on Ulasht.
1563-2850-3192-4885.description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Ulasht, creating a 1/1 Saporling creature token.
The Saproling token enters triggering Ivy Lane Denizen, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ulasht.
Activate the Saproling token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

751-4050-4054.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a creature token.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {U}.
Repeat.
